data.content_ref: inline:The target names the relation kind only as 'contradicts' and frames the dependence as a superficial directional inversion. The substantive relation is actually a *reduction with augmentation*: SRC_001 reduces SRC_002's one-sided discriminating test to a special case (operation not derivable from claim) and augments it with an inverse test (claim not derivable from operation), yielding a mutual-information constraint. Calling this a 'contradiction' of engine-neutrality mislabels an additive strengthening as opposition, so the stated kind does not match the actual structure linking the endpoints.
